title: Public Pathway Consolidation v2: identified cognition, memory transport, and mediated lifetime learning
summary: Rework PPC v1 without shrinking the project to a bundled demo. V2 closes current-item versus quarantined target visibility, causal-prefix serialization, typed REQUEST_DREAM, the normative THINK/DREAM state machine, restricted action-deletion credit, root-provenance algebra, treatment-level recurrence removal, strong bypass baselines, a fixed-corpus text/READ-LoRA transport assay, a READ/DECIDE factorial, meaningful cross-substrate accounting, claim-aligned promotion, full Stage-C epistemic-action mediation, capacity/statistical identification, independent sealing, and durable failure behavior. Parenting is removed to a separately gated future study and ENDPOINT is specified locally.
system_thesis: One recurrent base-plus-life-LoRA model emits public cognitive operations and actions; DREAM provisionally reconciles conscious context; SLEEP alone writes evidence-admitted runtime-format rows into the per-life LoRA. V2 is designed to determine whether authentic public pathways add value beyond endpoint imitation, whether local experiential records can be transported through LoRA independently of operation-policy learning, whether recurrent goal-conditioned traversal matters, and whether the resulting system creates a complete action-to-information-to-consolidation-to-later-action flywheel across genuinely growing post-context lives. Claims follow interventions and response surfaces, not architectural metaphor.

context_files.purpose: Controlling architecture, ratification, review, and GPU gates.
Verbatim triad and parenting direction plus objective-bound rework decisions.
Base protocol retained except where v2 supersedes conflicts.
Adversarial concern registry disposed by v2.
Adjudicated rework and two objective-resolved design forks.
Full flywheel, factorization, baselines, and claim invariants.
Post-context information-growth, capacity, and schema requirements.

nodes.before: V1 conflated current target transitions with quarantined results and lacked a complete leakage taxonomy.
nodes.after: Separate current-item public transitions, prior-item results, offline scores, hidden/oracle state, condition state, and side channels; build prompts/rows from causal-prefix allowlists and require counterfactual byte invariance.
nodes.rationale: Allows recurrent action within one item while forbidding future, cross-item, and target-derived training leakage.

nodes.before: REQUEST_DREAM, slice selection, branch ancestry, repeats, release, and schema/version behavior were ambiguous.
nodes.after: Freeze one normative operation state machine, typed charged REQUEST_DREAM payload, deterministic ancestor-closed slice, abandoned-branch exclusion, repeat limit, and prompt/schema/parser hashes.
nodes.rationale: Makes cognition uniquely executable and prevents goals or guesses laundering answers into sleep.

nodes.before: V1 risked applying exact-sequence action deletion to cognitive truth and counting synthetic views as independent support.
nodes.after: Deletion labels only exact-trace action necessity; cognitive rows are outcome-associated; root-equivalence sets, DAG topology, diamond handling, and disjoint-root support are explicit.
nodes.rationale: Preserves delayed setup actions without fabricating causal or epistemic credit.

nodes.before: One joint LoRA entangled memory transport, operation policy, action cloning, and recurrent computation.
nodes.after: Add fixed-corpus TEXT_READ versus READ_LORA transport, READ_LORA/DECIDE_LORA/PATH row factorial, PATH_ONE_SHOT recurrence removal, local ENDPOINT, and authentic shuffles/cuts.
nodes.rationale: The project objective requires component attribution rather than a bundled systems effect.

nodes.before: RAW and LINKED_TEXT were insufficient bypass controls and nominal all-arm equality was incoherent.
nodes.after: Require STANDARD, FULL_CONTEXT, TARGET_STATE_ONLY, RAW_RAG, EXPLICIT_GRAPH, LINKED_TEXT, ENDPOINT, factorial adapters, and class-specific resource matching with full cost/byte ledgers.
nodes.rationale: Tests against actual agent-memory alternatives while comparing resources that have meaningful counterparts.

nodes.before: V1 Stage C could show only condition-local updating and a fixed-rank curve.
nodes.after: Require intervention evidence across memory-conditioned epistemic action, new observation, later sleep admission, subsequent path use, and later value, plus post-native information growth, capacity/byte grids, and prospective statistics.
nodes.rationale: Identifies the full flywheel and distinguishes compression from spare capacity, exposure, or retrieval scaling.

nodes.before: Parenting and unratified ENDPOINT could enter by reference; byte-identical sealers and broad review could share bugs or hide resume changes.
nodes.after: Defer parenting, define ENDPOINT locally, require independent seal implementations, signature audits, a frozen lifecycle table, boundary fault injection, exact resume, and forbidden-suffix audit.
nodes.rationale: Keeps authority exact and preserves scientific identity across failures.

edges.before: A broad state object could contain future or abandoned-branch material.
edges.after: Only the active branch's allowlisted causal prefix can produce one charged operation; every forbidden mutation leaves input bytes unchanged.
edges.rationale: Closes future-state, answer, and condition leakage at the model boundary.

edges.before: Outcome association and DREAM agenda content could be mistaken for evidence.
edges.after: Committed roots determine support; dream/query/hypothesis bytes select candidates only, action deletion has restricted scope, and synthetic descendants add no evidence.
edges.rationale: Prevents the cognitive loop from self-certifying its own training data.

edges.before: The joint PATH treatment could not identify what LoRA learned or whether recurrence mattered.
edges.after: A fixed semantic corpus, row-family factorial, one-shot ablation, endpoint control, and path shuffles map each evidence class to a specific contrast.
edges.rationale: Separates recall transport, decision policy, authentic structure, recurrence, and action imitation.

edges.before: PATH could advance despite losing to strong external memory or without construct-specific causal evidence.
edges.after: Promotion follows construct gates and the strongest baseline; any winning external memory remains a Stage-C treatment and LoRA claims require LoRA superiority.
edges.rationale: Aligns compute allocation and later claims with the actual Stage-B evidence.

edges.before: On-policy divergence alone could be called a flywheel.
edges.after: Memory intervention changes an epistemic action; its observation is admitted; observation removal changes later path/action value; the cycle repeats over genuine information growth.

loops.before: V1 had an incompletely specified public operation loop and DREAM trigger.
loops.after: Execute the exact A3 THINK/DREAM state machine over A1/A2 causal-prefix inputs with one operation per call, fixed budgets, no invisible retry, and abandoned-branch exclusion.
loops.trigger: One committed current-item public state or typed REQUEST_DREAM.
writes: one typed operation or dream workspace
current-item public result when an action executes
loops.stop_condition: Valid STOP/DEFER, success/failure, exact budget exhaustion, repeat limit, ordinary incomplete status, or integrity stop.
loops.rationale: Closes operational ambiguity while leaving breadth/depth choices to the same model.

loops.before: V1 mixed restricted action evidence with positive cognitive and semantic supervision.
loops.after: Classify roots and exact action-deletion effects, keep cognitive operations outcome-associated, admit semantic claims only from public roots, render causal-prefix READ/DECIDE rows, and build locally specified ENDPOINT/factorial/shuffle conditions.
loops.trigger: A frozen source checkpoint with all eligible public outcomes committed.
loops.stop_condition: Atomic publication or fail-closed lifecycle state; no target-based repair or regeneration.
loops.rationale: Provides honest supervision and identifiable writer contrasts.

loops.before: V1 common-source assay lacked recurrence execution, complete baselines, construct gates, and transport factorization.
loops.after: Run the A5 conditions under A6 matching in both instruments; evaluate A7 scorecard, fixed-corpus transport, same-state mount, authentic shuffle/cut/twin, and independent seals.
loops.trigger: PPC2_T01 through PPC2_T08 pass and the exact Stage-B run is separately ratified.
loops.stop_condition: Complete audited panel or registered incomplete/integrity/futility state.
loops.rationale: Determines whether pathway consolidation and its substrate deserve a long-lifetime run.

loops.before: V1 proposed divergent lives and post-context curves without mediation or capacity identification.
loops.after: Execute A9 memory/action/observation/admission/path/value interventions over genuine post-native information growth, capacity/byte response surfaces, and prospective root-level inference.
loops.trigger: Stage B passes its claim-aligned promotion rule and a separate Stage-C protocol/manifest is ratified.
reads: sealed epistemic tasks and checkpoint panels
loops.stop_condition: Registered final checkpoint, exact futility boundary, ordinary incomplete state, or integrity failure.
loops.rationale: Tests the complete developmental flywheel rather than relabeling a bounded update curve.

loops.before: V1 allowed broad review to decide unspecified retry/resume/release behavior.
loops.after: Follow one frozen lifecycle table; resume only exact committed artifacts after ordinary failure; never retry target cells; stop and suppress numbers on integrity failure; compare actual suffix at audit.
loops.trigger: Every dispatch, parse, environment, commit, dream, sleep, train, publish, mount, cell, intervention, and audit boundary.
loops.stop_condition: Sole legal success/failure transition or audit rejection.
loops.rationale: Prevents operational recovery from silently changing the scientific experiment.

claims.before: V1 could attribute a joint PATH gain without executed recurrence or factorization.
claims.after: Stage B may claim pathway value beyond endpoint imitation only when PATH beats ENDPOINT, PATH_SHUFFLE, and PATH_ONE_SHOT and passes construct/cut gates; semantic connection claims remain PCFL-only.
claims.evidence_needed: Independent roots, prospective statistics, exact common source, construct scorecard, same-state mount, recurrence removal, authentic shuffles/cuts/twins, strong baselines, and postrun audit.

claims.before: V1 entangled local memory transport and next-operation policy in one q/v adapter.
claims.after: Fixed-corpus TEXT_READ versus READ_LORA may support transport, while READ_LORA/DECIDE_LORA/PATH may support only factorial effects identified by their registered contrasts.
claims.evidence_needed: Identical corpus/reader/thinker interface, read probes, row-family factorial, matched adapter training, and resource ledger.

claims.before: V1 Stage C could claim bounded on-policy improvement from divergent curves.
claims.after: A full flywheel claim requires memory-conditioned epistemic action, new observation, later admission, later path use, later value, all registered interventions, and post-native capacity/statistical evidence; saturation/compression language follows only observed response surfaces.
claims.evidence_needed: A9 mediation chain, yoked acquisition, memory/observation/path cuts, genuine information growth, new/old/cross-era panels, rank and retained-byte grid, independent roots, frozen inference, and postrun audit.

claims.before: V1 included parenting as a later stage in the same architecture artifact.
claims.after: Parenting remains a promising separate study of transferable learning priors but supports no current implementation, run, or claim.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate directive, task-information audit, wrong-lineage/outgrowability conditions, deliberation, and ratification.

claims.before: Fixed rank, action deletion, or joint improvement could be described as compression, cognitive truth, general memory superiority, or unbounded learning.
claims.after: Those descriptions are forbidden unless their exact A4--A9 interventions and response surfaces independently support them.
claims.evidence_needed: Evidence beyond any single bundled treatment or finite curve.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independent fixtures mutate every forbidden visibility class, future suffix, truth, score, condition, path, timing/error side channel, and cross-item result at each stage.
acceptance_tests.expected: All affected model inputs and writer rows remain byte-identical; only the immediately prior same-item public transition changes a later call in that item.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust every legal/illegal operation, branch ancestry, abandoned release, repeat, budget, typed REQUEST_DREAM, ancestor slice, prompt/schema/parser version, parse/provider failure, and DREAM publication transition.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly one next state/status is legal per case; no invisible retry, truncation of mandatory evidence, abandoned action/release, or self-support occurs.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Unique and safe execution of public cognition and reconciliation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independent CompilerGym/PCFL fixtures cover exact open-loop deletion, undefined replay, action-only necessity, outcome-associated cognition, root equivalence, paraphrases, diamonds, cycles, descendants, disjoint support, contradiction, and shortcut admission.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only exact action necessity and independently rooted semantic support receive their declared labels; synthetic views and descendants add no support.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Restricted credit assignment and provenance validity.

acceptance_tests.setup: Reconstruct local ENDPOINT, READ_LORA, DECIDE_LORA, PATH, PATH_SHUFFLE, PATH_ONE_SHOT, TEXT_READ, LINKED_TEXT, graph, RAG, and no-memory artifacts; verify rows, masks, candidate interfaces, budgets, full resource ledgers, training, publication, and mounts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Common inference budgets match; trained arms match training budgets; external substrates report complete distinct costs; factorial and fixed-corpus contrasts differ only as registered.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Writer factorization, transport attribution, recurrence comparison, or resource fairness.

acceptance_tests.setup: Production and independently authored no-import sealers freeze both instruments and compare identities, hashes, serialized target bytes, order, complements, twins, closure, passive signatures, classifiers, and standard-agent ceilings.
acceptance_tests.expected: Manifests are byte-identical despite independent implementations; source/target families and content are disjoint; registered shortcut/bypass ceilings hold.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Independent target construction and shortcut resistance.

acceptance_tests.setup: On development-only fixtures execute every A7 baseline, PATH_ONE_SHOT, authentic shuffle/cut/twin, same-state mount, and the eight-part construct scorecard under frozen budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Oracle closures and each metric/contrast are computable and separately gated; aggregate success cannot substitute for a failed construct or recurrence check.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the proposed experiment identifies connected recurrent pathway use against strong bypasses.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze Stage-C epistemic-action, memory/observation/path interventions, yoked control, C calculation, genuine-information checkpoints, rank/byte grid, sample-size source, independent unit, estimators, multiplicity, effect threshold, missingness, and futility rules.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every full-flywheel, compression, scaling, saturation, and crossover claim maps to prospective evidence and a hard falsifier; no target-driven choice remains.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Identifiability and statistical validity of the developmental paper claim.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh reviewer and non-overriding advocate bind exact composite architecture, implementation, T01-T07, lifecycle fault matrix, manifests, canary, and quantitative token/time/storage/GPU plan.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only an exact approval permits presenting one model/GPU manifest for later human ratification; otherwise rework.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scientific closure, constructibility, proportionality, or authority of the proposed execution.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh reviewer recomputes all actual prefixes, operations, roots, credits, rows, resources, baselines, interventions, statistics, mounts, target isolation, failure/resume transitions, ordered event suffix, and claim mapping.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only passing status-specific values/claims are released; integrity, visibility, budget, lifecycle, or estimator mismatch suppresses unsupported reporting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Every reported mechanism, transport, recurrence, mediation, compression, or lifetime result.

human_boundary.decision_question: After fresh v2 interpretations, cross-critique, and consensus, do you ratify the exact composite PPC v2 architecture and proposal-only scope, authorizing isolated contracts, CPU fixtures, and exactly two independently implemented no-model sealers while keeping parenting and every model/GPU execution behind later exact decisions?
forbidden_before_approval: Implementation, environment sealing, model calls, adapter training, GPU use, or result claims before exact v2 architecture ratification
Any Stage-B or Stage-C model/GPU execution before T01-T08 and later exact run-manifest ratification
Any current implementation or execution of parenting, Fable artifacts, or the unratified v9 endpoint design
Any hidden retry, regeneration, substitution, target-based repair, self-certified dream evidence, or claim beyond passing interventions
